annotations.title: Write post text for a clip

description: Write publish-ready post text for one clip with AI, tailored to each platform's tone and character limits, in the clip's language: { clip_index, posts: { [platform]: { title, description, hashtags } } }. title is only filled for YouTube (for the other platforms the caption is description, hashtags included). Omit platform to get all seven at once. Nothing is posted or saved and no video quota is used: show the text to the user, then pass it to katto_publish_clip (caption, or title/description for YouTube). Each call is a new AI generation (identical requests within an hour return the cached text).

platform.description: Platform to write for. Omit to get text for all seven.

name: katto_generate_post_text
